description: Place a video or sound file, or a video from a URL, into a new frame or an existing frame, with its media options (File > Place; Media panel > Video from URL)

bounds.description: Where to make it: a rectangle on a page, in mm from the page's top-left corner (all five values)

filePath.description: Video (MP4, F4V, FLV...) or sound (MP3...) file to place (give this or url)

frame.description: Id of an existing frame to place into (give this or bounds)

controller.description: Controller skin name for video, e.g. "SkinOverAllNoFullNoCaption"; "None" for no controller

description.description: Description: the PDF alternative text (PDF Options)

doNotPrintPoster.description: Do not print the sound poster (sound)

embedInPDF.description: Embed the media in the PDF rather than link to it

floatingWindow.description: Play in a floating window in the PDF (video, PDF Options)

floatingWindowPosition.description: Position of the floating window on the screen

floatingWindowSize.description: Size of the floating window relative to the video

loop.description: Loop (video: loops except in PDF; sound: loops forever)

poster.description: Poster: none, standard, from_video (a frame of the video, video only) or image (posterFile)

posterFile.description: Image file to use as the poster (sets poster to image)

showControllerOnRollover.description: Show the controller on mouse over (video)

showControls.description: Show playback controls in the PDF (legacy video option)

url.description: Play the video from this URL (Video from URL; video only)
URL of a video to play from the web (give this or filePath)

name: place_media
title: Place Media
